title: The Anchorage, Summercove, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17HF90
seoTitle: The Anchorage, Summercove, Kinsale, Co. Cork, P17HF90
description: Occupying one of the most exceptional waterfront settings in Ireland, The Anchorage is a distinguished Georgian residence, where timeless architecture, craftsmanship and an unrivalled harbour setting combine to create a home of extraordinary character. Extending to approximately 217 sq m (2,335 sq ft), the residence offers exceptionally proportioned accommodation that has been thoughtfully designed to maximise its magnificent waterfront setting. Beautifully positioned overlooking Kinsale Harbour, this remarkable period home has been carefully and sympathetically restored and upgraded over many years, with every enhancement undertaken to preserve its original architectural integrity while introducing the comforts and finishes expected of contemporary luxury living.Thoughtfully designed around its spectacular setting, almost every principal room enjoys uninterrupted views across the harbour, creating an ever-changing backdrop of sailing boats, shimmering water and magnificent sunsets. There is an extraordinary connection between the house and the harbour, with the ever-present water creating the remarkable sensation of living almost on the water itself—an experience that is immediately apparent upon entering the home. The accommodation unfolds naturally towards the waterfront, where elegant entertaining spaces and private family accommodation have been carefully arranged to maximise both light and outlook.At the heart of the home lies a magnificent harbour level where the bespoke kitchen, dining room and harbour room flow seamlessly together, each opening directly onto the expansive waterfront terrace. Whether enjoying morning coffee in the kitchen window seat, long lunches overlooking the water or evening drinks as yachts glide effortlessly through the harbour, these spaces create an exceptional environment for both everyday living and entertaining on a grand scale.A few steps above, the atmosphere changes to one of quiet elegance. The formal drawing room, complete with open fire and commanding harbour views, provides a sophisticated retreat for winter evenings and relaxed conversation. Beyond, a beautifully appointed library and study, discreetly separated by pocket doors, offers a peaceful sanctuary for reading, working from home or simply enjoying the tranquillity of this remarkable location.The entire first floor has been dedicated to an outstanding principal suite, creating a luxurious private apartment within the home. Entered through its own hallway, the accommodation comprises a spacious harbour-facing bedroom, an elegant walk-in dressing room and a beautifully appointed bathroom, all enjoying breathtaking panoramic views across Kinsale Harbour. It is a wonderfully peaceful retreat where every morning begins with one of Ireland's finest coastal vistas.Throughout the residence, exceptional attention has been given to both quality and authenticity. Restored teak windows incorporating Fineo vacuum glazing, bespoke solid ash cabinetry, rich walnut joinery, Italian marble flooring, black granite worktops, oak flooring and underfloor heating all combine to create interiors of timeless elegance while respecting the property's original character. Every improvement has been carefully considered to enhance comfort without compromising the home's heritage.The waterfront terrace is undoubtedly one of The Anchorage's defining features. Extending to approximately 53 sq m (570 sq ft), it provides an exceptional outdoor entertaining space overlooking Kinsale Harbour. More than simply an outdoor space, it functions as a natural extension of the living accommodation, perfectly positioned to embrace the spectacular harbour setting. From breakfast overlooking the water to summer entertaining with family and friends, Friday evening sailing races and unforgettable sunsets, it offers an extraordinary outdoor living experience that few homes can rival.Perfectly situated within the highly desirable village of Summercove, The Anchorage enjoys immediate access to many of Kinsale's most celebrated amenities. The Bulman, the scenic Scilly Walk, Charles Fort, Lower Cove and the vibrant town centre are all within easy reach, creating an enviable lifestyle that effortlessly combines waterfront tranquillity with the energy of one of Ireland's finest coastal towns.Adding further appeal, the separate garage and generous parking area, extending to approximately 58 sq m (624 sq ft), offer valuable flexibility, with potential—subject to the necessary planning permissions—to create additional guest accommodation, a home office, artist's studio or ancillary living space while retaining covered parking.The Anchorage is far more than an exceptional waterfront home. It is a residence of enduring quality and remarkable provenance that has evolved over centuries while remaining deeply connected to its spectacular maritime setting. Rarely does an opportunity arise to acquire a property that so perfectly balances history, craftsmanship, privacy and one of Ireland's most breathtaking harbour locations. For its next owners, The Anchorage offers not simply a home, but an extraordinary way of life.Kinsale is one of Ireland's most celebrated harbour towns, renowned for its rich maritime heritage, award-winning restaurants and vibrant atmosphere. Situated approximately 30 minutes from Cork City and just 20 minutes from Cork Airport, it offers excellent connectivity while retaining its relaxed coastal charm. The nearby towns of Carrigaline, Crosshaven and Bandon provide additional amenities, while the spectacular coastline of West Cork and the Wild Atlantic Way are within easy reach.
